examples.title: A podcast launch workspace
examples.invocation:

01-direction | audience.md|Define the listener | promise.md|Explain the show
02-format | structure.md|Shape each episode | schedule.md|Choose a cadence
03-content | topics.md|Build a topic list | outline.md|Plan the first episode
04-production | recording.md|Prepare the session | editing.md|Guide the edit
05-launch | show-page.md|Introduce the podcast | announce.md|Write the launch note
06-learning | feedback.md|Collect listener notes | review.md|Choose what improves
